主要内容: On January 31, 2017, DISH Network Corporation and EchoStar Corporation entered into a Share Exchange Agreement. EchoStar will transfer 100% of EB Splitco and ET Splitco equity to DISH in exchange for 6,290,499 shares of preferred stock. The transaction involves EchoStar's digital set-top boxes, satellite uplinking, streaming video technology, joint ventures, spectrum licenses, and real estate. It is subject to DISH's 10-Q filing for Q1 2017. The deal includes customary terms and is contingent on FCC radio licenses, no governmental challenges, EchoStar's completion of steps, and tax opinions. The transaction is expected to close three business days after conditions are met, no earlier than February 28, 2017. It may terminate by March 31, 2017, if not closed. EchoStar must complete in-orbit testing of the EchoStar XIX satellite. DISH and EchoStar will also enter into agreements on taxes, employees, IP, and transitional services. The transaction is part of DISH's strategy to expand its satellite broadband business through EchoStar's assets and operations.
